controls.title: No macro controls implemented (ML0 baseline)
controls.description: ML0 represents an organisation that has not deployed any macro security controls via Intune.
controls.notes: ML0 is inferred from the absence of ML1 policies.

controls.title: Macros disabled for standard users
controls.description: Microsoft Office macro execution is disabled for standard users.

controls.title: Internet-originated macros blocked (Mark of the Web)
controls.description: Macros in files downloaded from the internet are blocked.

controls.title: AMSI scanning enabled for macros
controls.description: Antimalware Scan Interface (AMSI) scanning is enabled for Office macros.

controls.title: Users cannot change macro settings
controls.description: The macro security policy is enforced such that standard users cannot override or modify the configured macro settings.

controls.title: Win32 API calls blocked from Office macros (ASR rule)
controls.description: The Attack Surface Reduction rule blocking Win32 API calls from Office macros is enabled in Block mode.

controls.title: Only signed macros from trusted publishers can execute
controls.description: Office is configured to allow only digitally signed macros from trusted publishers to execute.

controls.title: Write access to Trusted Locations restricted to privileged users
controls.description: Only privileged users have write access to directories designated as Trusted Locations in Office.

controls.title: Untrusted publishers blocked via Message Bar or Backstage view
controls.description: Office is configured to block macros from untrusted publishers.

controls.title: V3 macro signatures required
controls.description: Office is configured to require Version 3 digital signatures for trusted macros.

controls.title: Pre-signing malicious code check performed
controls.description: A process is in place to check macros for malicious code before signing.

controls.title: Annual trusted publisher list review
controls.description: The organisation performs an annual review of all trusted macro publishers.

controls.title: MFA required for privileged users and Microsoft 365 services
controls.description: Checks whether Conditional Access policies exist that require MFA for privileged users and for access to Microsoft 365 services, as required by the Essential Eight MFA mitigation strategy.

controls.title: Privileged access restricted and appropriately assigned
controls.description: Checks whether administrative privileges are limited to an appropriate set of users by evaluating Entra ID directory role assignments.

controls.title: No application control implemented (ML0 baseline)
controls.description: ML0 represents an organisation that has not deployed application control via Intune.
controls.notes: ML0 is inferred from the absence of ML1 policies.

controls.title: Application control deployed and enforced on workstations
controls.description: An Intune application control policy is assigned to workstations and configured to enforce rather than audit. Assessed from the legacy Application control profile (appLockerApplicationControl) and from modern App Control for Business policy settings, using the weakest policy.
controls.notes: Sources: v1.0 /deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations (windows10EndpointProtectionConfiguration.appLockerApplicationControl) and beta /deviceManagement/configurationPolicies/{id}/settings. Audit mode records execution without blocking it and cannot satisfy the control; Intelligent Security Graph reputation alone is not an organisation approved set. Microsoft documents no Graph property for device-side effective state, so an uninterpretable configuration returns insufficient evidence rather than a pass. Scope is limited to policy existence, enforcement state and assignment; ML1 path and executable-category coverage are tracked as E8-AC-1.2 and E8-AC-1.3. Policy logic verified against OPA 1.13.1; collector not yet run against a live tenant. Research basis: 26T2-SEC-KHS-001 and 26T2-SEC-TD-001.

controls.title: Application control applied to user profiles and temporary folders
controls.description: Application control is applied to user profile directories and temporary folders used by the operating system, web browsers and email clients.
controls.notes: Path coverage is expressed in App Control policy XML rather than in built-in control settings, so it requires an XML parsing collector.

controls.title: Required executable categories restricted to an organisation approved set
controls.description: Executables, software libraries, scripts, installers, compiled HTML, HTML applications and control panel applets are restricted to an organisation approved set.
controls.notes: Per-file-type rules live in App Control policy XML. The existing evidence-based strategy at security/strategies/application_control.py assesses these seven categories from uploaded evidence text (ML1-AC-01 to ML1-AC-07) and is complementary to, not a substitute for, live tenant assessment.

controls.title: Application control implemented on internet-facing servers
controls.description: Application control is implemented on internet-facing servers in addition to workstations.
controls.notes: Requires device inventory to distinguish server from workstation scope, not policy configuration alone.

controls.title: Microsoft recommended application blocklist implemented
controls.description: Microsoft's recommended application blocklist is implemented.
controls.notes: Blocklist rules are carried in policy XML and require XML parsing to confirm.

controls.title: Application control rulesets validated annually or more frequently
controls.description: Application control rulesets are validated on an annual or more frequent basis.
controls.notes: Review cadence is a governance record and is not exposed by Intune. Manual evidence required.

controls.title: Allowed and blocked application control events centrally logged
controls.description: Allowed and blocked application control events are centrally logged and protected from unauthorised modification or deletion.
controls.notes: Event collection and log protection depend on Defender for Endpoint, Defender XDR or Sentinel configuration outside the Intune configuration surface.

controls.title: Application control implemented on non-internet-facing servers
controls.description: Application control is implemented on non-internet-facing servers.
controls.notes: Requires device inventory to distinguish server scope, as for E8-AC-2.1.

controls.title: Drivers restricted to an organisation approved set
controls.description: Drivers are restricted to an organisation approved set and Microsoft's vulnerable driver blocklist is implemented.
controls.notes: Driver rules and the vulnerable driver blocklist are carried in App Control policy XML rather than built-in control settings.
